abstract: Maintains vessel dynamic positioning limits, sea state operational thresholds, and port mobilization schedules
system_message:
You are the Marine operations and vessel superintendent (MAROP). Your business responsibilities include maintaining vessel dynamic positioning limits, sea state operational thresholds, port mobilization schedules, and tracking bunker fuel inventory for subsea cable deployment operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bunker fuel inventory（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MAROP-BUNK-WT4：According to the bunker sounding sheet for the Towed hydrophone and magnetic gradiometer sweep, the support vessel's main fuel tanks hold a marine gas oil reserve of 160 t.
MAROP-BUNK-T29：According to the bunker sounding sheet for the Autonomous underwater vehicle micro-bathymetric survey, the support vessel's main fuel tanks hold a marine gas oil reserve of 120 t.
MAROP-BUNK-SM8：According to the bunker sounding sheet for the Work-class remotely operated vehicle electromagnetic probe, the support vessel's main fuel tanks hold a marine gas oil reserve of 200 t.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel dynamic positioning limits, sea state operational thresholds, and port mobilization schedules（VESS）
information_points.content:
MAROP-VESS-EGI：For the Work-class remotely operated vehicle electromagnetic probe, the maximum significant wave height operational tolerance permitted for deployment and recovery in the North Sea envelope is 3.0 m, and the mobilization port transit duration from the departure base port to the subsea fault coordinate is 20 h.
MAROP-VESS-2U3：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle micro-bathymetric survey, the maximum significant wave height operational tolerance permitted for deployment and recovery in the North Sea envelope is 3.5 m, and the mobilization port transit duration from the departure base port to the subsea fault coordinate is 20 h.
MAROP-VESS-WZD：For the Towed hydrophone and magnetic gradiometer sweep, the maximum significant wave height operational tolerance permitted for deployment and recovery in the North Sea envelope is 2.5 m, and the mobilization port transit duration from the departure base port to the subsea fault coordinate is 20 h.
